Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Bahá'u'lláh (author, Wikidata Q101054), died 1892. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bahá'u'lláh, 1817-1892") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Hiddenwords Bahaullah, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/hiddenwordsbahaullah. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 77%, 100%, 92% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Bahá'u'lláh, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
